properties.text: Engineering managers shall maintain approved policy governance and controlled exception handling for all production services.
Service teams shall apply secure SDLC practices including threat-informed design and secure coding standards.
Engineering systems shall enforce strong authentication, least privilege, and periodic access review.
Code changes shall follow controlled release processes with rollback readiness and risk-based approvals.
Software components shall be tracked, verified, and license-compliant across the supply chain.
Releases shall satisfy quality gates with automated and risk-based test evidence before deployment.
Production services shall maintain reliability objectives, observability baselines, and recovery readiness.
Security vulnerabilities and incidents shall be triaged, remediated, and escalated within defined SLAs.
Data handling and privacy safeguards shall be implemented proportionate to data sensitivity and legal obligations.
Access and security logging shall be retained and reviewable to support traceability and audit evidence.
Maintain Policy Governance and Exception Management
Execute Secure SDLC Practices
Enforce Engineering Identity and Access Controls
Ensure Release and Change Safety
Assure Software Supply Chain Integrity
Enforce Test and Quality Gates
Maintain Reliability and Operational Readiness
Operate Vulnerability and Incident Response
Implement Data Protection and Privacy Engineering
Maintain Logging and Audit Traceability

properties.title: Engineering Policy Governance
properties.description: Must define governance scope and review boundaries; out-of-scope product exceptions require documented approval. Shall require annual review and measurable adherence reporting by policy owners.

properties.title: Secure SDLC Policy
properties.description: Must enforce secure design and coding controls for all internet-facing services; out-of-scope prototypes are prohibited in production. Shall require threat model review before release and measurable secure defect trend reporting.

properties.title: Access Control for Engineering Tooling
properties.description: Must enforce least privilege and MFA on engineering systems; break-glass use requires approved exceptions. Shall require quarterly access reviews and measurable stale-access reduction outcomes.

properties.title: Change and Release Control
properties.description: Must classify release risk and enforce approval boundaries; emergency bypasses require documented exceptions. Shall require rollback readiness evidence and measurable release-failure-rate objectives.

properties.title: Third-Party Component and License Policy
properties.description: Must maintain dependency provenance and license compliance boundaries; prohibited licenses require approved exceptions. Shall require periodic SBOM review and measurable critical-dependency exposure reduction.

properties.title: Test and Quality Gate Policy
properties.description: Must enforce mandatory quality gates by release risk class; waiver requests require approved exceptions. Shall require regression coverage review and measurable escaped-defect reduction.

properties.title: Reliability and Service Operations Policy
properties.description: Must define SLO and on-call boundaries for production services; temporary target changes require approved exceptions. Shall require monthly reliability review and measurable error-budget compliance.

properties.title: Vulnerability Management and Remediation Policy
properties.description: Must define triage and remediation SLAs by severity boundaries; SLA extension requests require approved exceptions. Shall require weekly remediation review and measurable high-severity aging control.

properties.title: Data Handling and Privacy Engineering Policy
properties.description: Must classify data handling boundaries and privacy safeguards by sensitivity tier; processing exceptions require approved approval path. Shall require periodic privacy review and measurable sensitive-data exposure reduction.

properties.title: Logging and Audit Retention Policy
properties.description: Must retain audit logs with clear retention boundaries; retention deviations require approved exceptions. Shall require evidence review cadence and measurable audit retrieval completeness.

properties.title: Policy Lifecycle and Exception Workflow Standard
properties.description: Define policy lifecycle steps, policy template requirements, and exception review workflow with quarterly governance sign-off.

properties.title: Threat Modeling and Secure Coding Standard
properties.description: Define required threat modeling steps, secure coding checks, and release entry criteria for high-risk changes.

properties.title: MFA, RBAC, and Access Review Standard
properties.description: Define MFA enforcement, role-based access control procedures, and quarterly access recertification checkpoints.

properties.title: Release Risk and Rollback Standard
properties.description: Define release risk scoring, approval rules, and tested rollback procedures for production deployments.

properties.title: Dependency Provenance and License Review Standard
properties.description: Define SBOM generation, provenance attestation checks, and license compliance review checkpoints for all releases.

properties.title: Risk-Based Quality Gate Standard
properties.description: Define mandatory test suites by risk class and release gating criteria with waiver escalation procedures.

properties.title: SLO and Operational Readiness Standard
properties.description: Define SLO baseline requirements, on-call readiness checks, and resilience validation steps before major releases.

properties.title: Vulnerability Triage and Patch SLA Standard
properties.description: Define triage workflow, patch SLA windows by severity, and verification steps for remediation closure.

properties.title: Data Classification and Privacy Safeguard Standard
properties.description: Define data classification classes, privacy safeguard controls, and evidence requirements for regulated processing.

properties.title: Structured Logging and Audit Retention Standard
properties.description: Define structured log schema, retention windows, and immutable evidence retrieval procedures for audits.

properties.title: Quarterly Policy Governance Board Review
properties.description: Manual review verifies policy lifecycle completion, exception approvals, and overdue policy remediation.

properties.title: Pre-Release Threat Model Enforcement Check
properties.description: Automated pipeline gate verifies required threat model and secure coding checklist for qualifying releases.

properties.title: MFA and RBAC Configuration Audit
properties.description: Automated audit verifies MFA enforcement and least-privilege role assignments for engineering systems.

properties.title: Release Risk and Rollback Readiness Check
properties.description: Automated gate verifies release risk approval and tested rollback plan evidence before deployment.

properties.title: SBOM Provenance and License Compliance Scan
properties.description: Automated scan verifies dependency provenance attestations and license policy conformance for release artifacts.

properties.title: Risk-Based Test Gate Verification
properties.description: Automated release gate verifies required test suite pass conditions for the assigned release risk class.

properties.title: Monthly SLO and Readiness Review
properties.description: Manual review verifies SLO adherence, incident trends, and operational readiness checklist completion.

properties.title: Severity-Based Patch SLA Compliance Check
properties.description: Automated check verifies vulnerability remediation closure times meet severity-based SLA thresholds.

properties.title: Quarterly Privacy Safeguard Conformance Review
properties.description: Manual review verifies data classification controls and privacy safeguard implementation evidence.

properties.title: Structured Log Retention and Retrieval Check
properties.description: Automated check verifies required log retention and successful retrieval of immutable audit evidence samples.
